## One email thread in, evidence out

Called once per thread by `74 - RUN - Monthly Update`. It reads the full
thread, strips quoted replies and signatures, compacts it to fit a model
context, and asks Claude for the facts it can actually prove.

Every event and metric it returns carries the message IDs it came from. A
claim without message IDs is dropped upstream, which is what keeps the
finished update honest.

Gmail access here is read-only. It cannot send, reply, label, or delete.
